opening: I've been having twitches that I can't control.
I've been making sounds that I can't control.
The whistling came after the face twitches started.
It all started suddenly, 3 days ago.
I've been more jumpy than usual.
I keep going over things in my head and can't stop.
My wife and I separated four months ago.
One week before the tics started I went into my daughter's room, the first time since the separation.
A former coworker of mine has Tourette's syndrome.

opening.text: I've been having twitches that I can't control, and I've been making whistling sounds that I can't control. It all started suddenly, three days ago, and the whistling came after the face twitches started. I've been more jumpy than usual, sleeping less, and I keep going over things in my head and can't stop. My wife and I separated four months ago, and one week before the tics started I went into my daughter's room, the first time since the separation. A former coworker of mine has Tourette's syndrome.
